title: Error bounds for the Sherman-Morrison formula and its modification with improved stability
summary: It is known that the Sherman--Morrison (SM) formula is not numerically stable. In recent work, we introduced SMIR, an algorithm that incorporates iterative refinement to enhance the SM backward error. In this paper we take a different route: adapting an algorithm of Govaerts, originally designed for general bordered linear systems, we develop a modified Sherman--Morrison (MSM) method whose built-in self-correction makes it surprisingly resilient.
